notes: BloxImd (BLOX) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender. It has no subsequent minting, privileged roles, or transfer fees. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
